The unannotated integral uses volume, and Euclidean volume is the coordinate Lebesgue measure (PiLp's coordinate equivalence is volume preserving). Their localized guards exclude [] and tensor order 0, so they never require compact support of the nonzero background U. ScalarField enumerates exactly density, densityTime, T, A_j, B_j, H_j.
